scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Try to continue after reducing those objects.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了。请减少物品种类后再尝试。

scripts.text: You have too many heavy objects. Try to continue after reducing your weight.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太重了。请减轻负重后再尝试。

scripts.text:
[Albo]
Who are you?
We don't need a weaking!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
你是谁？
我们不需要弱者！！

scripts.text:
[Albo]
We crossed the sea!
We are great heroes of Culvert! We do not forgive the seafood that aims at Culvert!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
我们渡过了大海！
我们是下水道的英雄！我们绝不原谅那些企图侵犯下水道的海鲜！

scripts.text:
[Albo]
We used to be the henchmen of Mr. Missing! We almost became guards of such a historic site.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
我们曾经是失踪先生的手下！我们差点就成为了这个历史遗迹的卫兵。

scripts.text:
[Albo]
However, when sea water flooded all precious the resources, my dream... all my dreams melted away...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
然而，当海水淹没了所有珍贵的资源，我的梦想...我所有的梦想都随之消散了...

scripts.text:
[Albo]
We do not forgive the seafood that invaded our territory. I'll eat them with spicy paste!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
我们绝不原谅那些入侵我们领地的海鲜。我要把它们拌上辣酱吃掉！！！

scripts.text: ^0000ffAlbo's voice shakes with anger. He smacked his lips when he mentioned spicy paste.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff阿尔博的声音因愤怒而颤抖。当他提到辣酱时，他舔了舔嘴唇。^000000

scripts.text:
[Albo]
That task is really hard for you, so I can't tell you about it. Why don't you find another one?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
那个任务对你来说太难了，所以我不能告诉你详情。你为什么不找找别的任务呢？

scripts.text:
[Albo]
I'm sorry. There is no new task yet! If I find any work, I'll tell you so!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
抱歉。目前还没有新任务！如果我有工作，我会告诉你的！

scripts.text:
[Albo]
Uh!? Where is the task? Let me find that quickly. You must speak with Madeca!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
咦！？任务在哪里？让我赶紧找找。你必须去和马德卡对话！

scripts.text:
[Albo]
Today, the heroes of Culvert!
We raise our voices and set a date for the extermination of ^0000ff{0}^000000!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
今天，下水道的英雄们！
我们要高呼口号，并确定消灭 ^0000ff{0}^000000 的日期！

scripts.text: [Albo]
scripts.translation: [阿尔博]

scripts.text:
[Albo]
Come on, heroes! Don't be afraid of them! Just go on, since it's a one-day mission!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
来吧，英雄们！不要害怕它们！继续前进吧，毕竟这是一天的任务！

scripts.text:
[Albo]
I'll give you one week to finish this job! Terminate all of them in Culvert Dungeon, Normal Mode!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
我给你一周时间完成这个任务！在下水道副本（普通模式）中消灭它们！

scripts.text:
[Albo]
I'll give you one week to finish this job! Terminate all of them in Culvert Dungeon, Hard Mode!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔博]
我给你一周时间完成这个任务！在下水道副本（困难模式）中消灭它们！

scripts.text: You received a request for the Extermination of ^005500{0}^000000. If you need more details, please check the quest window.
scripts.translation: 你收到了消灭 ^005500{0}^000000 的请求。如果需要更多详情，请查看任务窗口。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Try to continue after reducing those objects.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了。请减少物品种类后再尝试。

scripts.text: You have too many heavy objects. Try to continue after reducing your weight.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太重了。请减轻负重后再尝试。

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
Karrrrrrr!!
Let's have some bad seafood that can be boiled or grilled!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
嘎嘎嘎嘎！！
让我们吃些可以水煮或烧烤的劣质海鲜吧！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
Who are you? You are such a totterer. Even seaweed could kill you!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
你是谁？你真是个胆小鬼。连海草都能把你杀掉！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
Oh?
You're the one who took care of my big brother Albo's request. It was a hard job!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
哦？
你是那个处理了我大哥阿尔博请求的人。那是个艰难的任务！

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: General Culvert Daily Service Compensation
scripts.translation: 普通下水道每日服务报酬

scripts.text: Hard Culvert Daily Service Compensation
scripts.translation: 困难下水道每日服务报酬

scripts.text: General Culvert Weekly Service Compensation
scripts.translation: 普通下水道每周服务报酬

scripts.text: Hard Culvert Weekly Service Compensation
scripts.translation: 困难下水道每周服务报酬

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
I'm here to help my big brother Albo!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
我来帮大哥阿尔博的忙！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
We provide precious materials to humans who make sludge out of the bad seafood in the Culverts!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
我们为那些把下水道里的劣质海鲜做成污泥的人类提供珍贵材料！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
We provide A~B Grade Coins as compensation for daily service, and the precious Sea God's Wrath as compensation for weekly service.
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
每日服务报酬是A~B级硬币，每周服务报酬是珍贵的海神之怒。

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
If you take care of big brother Albo's request, I will see you very often. So, let's stay close!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
如果你能完成大哥阿尔博的请求，我会经常见到你的。所以，我们要保持亲近哦！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
I can't give you compensation for an expired request, so let me check if any of yours have expired.
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
过期的请求无法领取报酬，让我检查一下你有没有过期的任务。

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
Something is wrong. Please check this again!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
出错了。请再检查一次！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
I don't see any completed mission!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
我没有看到任何已完成的任务！

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
Um, I'm sorry. You exceeded the time limit, so I can't give you any payment.
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
嗯，抱歉。你超过了时限，所以我无法支付报酬。

scripts.text:
[Madeca]
You've punished ^0000ff{0}^000000!
Here's your pay!
scripts.translation:
[马德卡]
你惩罚了^0000ff{0}^000000！
这是你的报酬！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Are you talking to me?!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你在跟我说话吗？！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I'm not sure what made you come here but you can't enter!
Tomas' orders...
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我不知道你为什么来这里，但你不能进去！
托马的命令...

scripts.text: ^770099You must be Base level 90 to enter.^000000

[Missing, the Cleaner]
(trembling)
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
(颤抖)

scripts.text: ^660066This cat looks like it's in bad shape. It is slightly trembling.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066这只猫看起来状态很差。它在轻微颤抖。^000000

scripts.text: Pet the cat
scripts.translation: 抚摸猫

scripts.text: Are you ok?
scripts.translation: 你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Are you talking to me?!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你在跟我说话吗？！

scripts.text: ^660066A trembling cat is looking up at you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066一只颤抖的猫正抬头看着你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Achoo!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
阿嚏！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
We have had many issues during the
cleaning of the culverts. But a
cat's gotta do it...
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
在清理下水道的时候，我们遇到了很多麻烦。
但身为一只猫，总得做点什么...

scripts.text: What culvert are you cleaning?
scripts.translation: 你在清理哪条下水道？

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
It might look unfamiliar for an
outsider, but actually this place
is made to keep souvenirs and
luxurious things.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
对外人来说，这里可能看起来很陌生。
但实际上，这个地方是用来存放纪念品和奢侈品的。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
After there was a big trembling on
this island, things started leaking
around here. So that's why I became
a cleaner here, though I used
to be a manager.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
这座岛发生大地震后，这里就开始漏水了。
所以我成了这里的清洁工，虽然我以前是管理员。

scripts.text: ^660066The cat looks like it's been crying...^000000

[Missing, the Cleaner]
There is a culvert along this way
to the basement. There are many bad
guys who hurt me. I am tired of
fighting with them so many times a
day!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
通往地下的路上有一条下水道。
那里有很多坏人欺负我。
我受够了每天和他们打那么多架！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Ohh! You touched my fur!
My fur is falling out... it's all
those guys' fault~
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
噢！你摸我的毛了！
我的毛在掉...都是那些家伙的错~

scripts.text: ^660066You just now notice that the cat's fur is missing in some places.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066你这才注意到，这只猫的毛有些地方已经秃了。^000000

scripts.text: Why don't you just quit!
scripts.translation: 你为什么不干脆辞职呢！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I still have to make a living, don't I?
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我还得谋生，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Sometimes I can get a lucky box,
or even better, I can get cans...
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
有时候我能捡到幸运盒子，
或者更好的，能捡到罐头...

scripts.text: Okay, cheers!
scripts.translation: 好的，干杯！

scripts.text: I will help if possible...
scripts.translation: 如果可能的话，我会帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Thank you. I am going back to pour the water!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
谢谢。我要回去倒水了！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
(turns down his voice)
If you really want to help, come closer!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
(压低声音)
如果你真的想帮忙，靠近一点！

scripts.text: (get in closer)
scripts.translation: (靠近一点)

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Not everyone can be an assistant
here. But I can't help choosing
anyone at the moment...
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
不是每个人都能在这里当助手。
但我现在没法随便选人...

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
If you want to go down here, let me get this code.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
如果你想下去，让我先拿一下这个密码。

scripts.text: ^660066The cat scribbles a memo for code to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066猫用涂鸦给你写了一张密码备忘。^000000

scripts.text: Open the memo.
scripts.translation: 打开备忘

scripts.text: ^660000Aragam insulted me.^000000

[Missing, the Cleaner]
You must be here with friends
because you can't go in alone! And
the password code will be from the
party leader!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你肯定是和朋友一起来的，
因为不能一个人进去！
而且密码必须由队伍首领提供！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
What is also important is you must
have a Seagod Protection with you.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
还有一点很重要，
你必须持有海神护符。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Don't forget! I will not open the
door if you do not have Seagod Protection!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
别忘了！
如果没有海神护符，我不会开门的！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
You don't look like you have Seagod Protection. I can't open door at the moment!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你看起来没有海神护符。我现在不能开门！

scripts.text:
^0000ffYou have to organize a party of
more than 1 member or be a member
of the party and come back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000ff你需要组建一个成员超过1人的队伍，
或者加入一个队伍，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Ummm? What's up? Tell me the password if you're the leader!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
嗯？怎么了？如果你是首领，请告诉我密码！

scripts.text: No... nothing.
scripts.translation: 不...没什么。

scripts.text: Aragam insulted me.
scripts.translation: 阿拉甘侮辱了我。

scripts.text: Enter the Culvert.
scripts.translation: 进入下水道

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
What a rookie.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
真是个小菜鸟。

scripts.text:
^3333FF{0}^000000 - Reserving
After making the reservation, you
have to select Enter the Culvert.
scripts.translation:
^3333FF{0}^000000 - 预约中
预约成功后，
你需要选择“进入下水道”。

scripts.text: Enter Culvert
scripts.translation: 进入下水道

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You can enter the Culvert if the gate is open.
scripts.translation: 如果大门打开，你就可以进入下水道了。

scripts.text: Enter Culvert
scripts.translation: 进入下水道

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe gate to the Culvert is open again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff通往下水道的大门再次打开了。^000000

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
The gate to the Culvert is still closed.
You must wait until you are able to enter or find a party leader who can create the instance.
scripts.translation:
通往下水道的大门仍然关闭。
你必须等待直到可以进入，
或者找一个能创建副本的队伍首领。

scripts.text: Only party members can participate.
scripts.translation: 只有队伍成员才能参与。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I am trying to have a conversation with your leader now. Please don't disturb and wait!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我正在与你们的首领交谈。
请不要打扰，稍等片刻！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
This is the underground culvert where you will clean with your friends!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
这就是你们要和朋友们一起清洁的下水道！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I'll open the door first. By the way, do you know how to fight?
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我先去开门。
顺便问一下，你们知道怎么战斗吗？

scripts.text: I'm pretty good at delivering bread.
scripts.translation: 我送面包很厉害。

scripts.text: I know how to fight.
scripts.translation: 我知道怎么战斗。

scripts.text: ^ffffffGive me the diamond.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ffffff把钻石给我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Ok then, I'll let you clean the culverts here as usual! I will prepare at the right-hand corner, please follow me!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
好的，那就请你们像往常一样清洁下水道吧！
我会在右手边角落准备，请跟我来！

scripts.text: Wait! I changed my mind!
scripts.translation: 等等！我改变主意了！

scripts.text: As you wish~
scripts.translation: 如你所愿~

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Huh? Not ready yet? Talk to me again when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
咦？还没准备好吗？
准备好了再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Hmmm... Missing thinks you're weak! Tell me the truth!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
嗯...米辛觉得你们很弱！
告诉我实话！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Huh? You have some fighting skills? Well, then, there is one place I wasn't able to clean... why don't you go there?!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
咦？你们有点战斗技巧？
好吧，那么，有一处地方我一直没能清理干净...你们去那里看看怎么样？！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I must tell you that it's been such a long~~ time since we've cleaned that place, so anyone under level 140 cannot even enter! Are you sure you still want to go?
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我得告诉你们，那里已经很久~~没有清理过了，
所以140级以下的玩家甚至无法进入！
你们确定还要去吗？

scripts.text: Wait! I changed my mind!
scripts.translation: 等等！我改变主意了！

scripts.text: Sure, I'm prepared already~
scripts.translation: 当然，我已经准备好了~

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Hmm? Talk to me again when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
嗯？准备好了再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I told you not to play with me~!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我说过不要跟我开玩笑~！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I will tell you how to clean shortly. Can you see the culverts around you?
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我马上告诉你们怎么清洁。
你们能看到周围的下水道吗？

scripts.text: What culverts??
scripts.translation: 什么下水道？

scripts.text: Yes, I see them.
scripts.translation: 是的，我看到了。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Huh? Is this your first time seeing culverts? You'll see many buried machines in the ground. You may look around and come back!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
咦？这是你们第一次看到下水道吗？
你们会看到很多埋在地下机器。
可以四处看看，然后回来！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
That's right! Those culverts are very important! We must clean the culverts to prevent seaweed from blocking them. This is what we, cleaners, do!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
没错！那些下水道非常重要！
我们必须清洁下水道，防止海草堵塞它们。
这就是我们清洁工的工作！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Watch out! Some monsters will be after you while you're cleaning the culverts! But do not yield to them!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
小心！在清洁下水道时，有些魔物会袭击你们！
但千万不要向它们屈服！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
And... NEVER let 6 seaweeds stack! Up to 5 is acceptable! If there are 6, I'll drag you out of here!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
还有...绝对不能让6个海草堆叠在一起！
最多只能有5个！
如果有6个，我就把你们拖出去！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I don't care if you get help from your friends or not. I want you to clean up all culverts! Don't forget! I will watch you and give you instructions. Just do what I said!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我不在乎你们是否寻求朋友的帮助。
我要你们清洁所有的下水道！
别忘了！我会看着你们并给你们指示。
照我说的做！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Once your leader finishes preparing, it will begin, so get your hearts ready for it!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
一旦你们的首领准备完毕，游戏就会开始，
所以请做好心理准备！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
So, are you ready to clean now?
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
那么，你们准备好开始清洁了吗？

scripts.text: Wait! Not yet!
scripts.translation: 等等！还没准备好！

scripts.text: Let's start!
scripts.translation: 开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Huh? Not ready yet? Then talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
咦？还没准备好？
那等你们准备好了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
OK! Now it begins!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
好！现在开始！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I have the cleaning job for 40 years and I've never seen such a terrible team!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我做了40年的清洁工作，
还从未见过这么糟糕的队伍！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I see seaweed everywhere because you're wiggling! All the culverts will be blocked with seaweed!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
因为你们在乱动，所以我到处都看到海草！
所有的下水道都会被海草堵住的！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Once your leader finishes preparing, settlement will be decided so get your hearts ready for it!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
一旦你们的首领准备完毕，结算就会开始，
所以请做好心理准备！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
If you got some guts to challenge again, I'll give you another chance! What's your choice going to be!?
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
如果你们有胆量再挑战一次，
我会再给你们一次机会！
你们的选择是什么！？

scripts.text: Wait! Not yet!
scripts.translation: 等等！还没准备好！

scripts.text: Okay, let's start again!
scripts.translation: 好，重新开始！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
You're still slow! Talk to me again whenever your're ready.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你们还是太慢了！
等你们准备好了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
Ok! Let's start now!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
好！现在开始！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I was very surprised!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我真的很惊讶！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
That funny-looking fish seems to be one of Coelacanths living around here. This is my first time seeing one coming here alone!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
那条长相奇怪的鱼似乎是生活在这里的腔棘鱼之一。
这是我第一次看到它单独来这里！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I'll clean up the remains. Go pack and leave! Enterance is located on the other side, look for it!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我会清理残骸的。
收拾东西离开吧！
入口在另一边，找找看！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
You've destroyed an immense monster!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你们竟然消灭了一只巨大的魔物！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
The one you destroyed was among the variety of Coelacanths. Others have tried to destroy them but failed.
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
你们消灭的那只是腔棘鱼的一种。
之前也有人尝试消灭它们，但都失败了。

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
I'll clean up the remains. You go ahead to get trophies and leave!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
我会清理残骸的。
你们去收集战利品，然后离开吧！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
One more thing! DO NOT TALK to ANYONE about what you've seen here today!!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
还有一件事！
绝对不要告诉任何人你们今天在这里看到的东西！！

scripts.text:
[Missing, the Cleaner]
If Tomas closes this down, we will lose our jobs!
scripts.translation:
[清洁工 米辛]
如果托马把这里关闭了，我们就失业了！
